Absolutely FANTASTIC experience. It's like The Cat Lady meets Silent Hill meets Twin Peaks. The atmosphere is incredible, the art style is beautiful, the simultaneous serenity and buildup of suspension and tension is *chef's kiss*.  The writing is already captivating, I was HOOKED instantly. The characters are intriguing and the ones you do see are intriguing by themselves and in their interactions.

This literally just became my #1 most anticipated game of the year (yes, even over GTA 6).

It's got really good vibes, the soundtrack is iconic and the aesthetics from this game are immaculate, I wish they went about the gameplay loop differently however

I feel like instead of making path to the endings short, and forcing the player to loop from the beginning, it would've been much better if the game's first playthrough took around 20 hours to beat, with less endings, because as it stands, the game just doesn't feel very replayable after you reach the ending, you've already met and spoken to all the NPC's, seen most of what the world has to offer essentially, I mean sure.. the people's VISITOR status changes each playthrough, but for me it wasn't enough to make it replayable, I don't think this game should've aimed for that.

Regardless, I will recommend this game based on it's art, story, aesthetics & music.

I want to be very clear about this. I am an avid tactical RPG player. This game is very good. It's a huge step up in acting and dialogue, but I expect that of a game with this prestige and budget.

Unfortunately, I was told that the tactical combat would be a huge upgrade to what we've seen. It's a sidegrade at best, I'm sorry. The advancement is little more than "do 1 more damage." Feels like a real side grade compared to what felt like reasonably deep progression in XCOM 2, its clear ancestor.

This is the kind of game that can absolutely change someone. It's addicting, satisfying, and always challenging! No matter how many times I lost, I still kept going. I still remember when I was simply trying to get my first ever win and it's feels amazing to see how far I've come. After 100% completion, I can safely say that Balatro is simply phenomenal!

A fun little metroidvania that doesn't take too long to beat (I spent an extra couple hours going for bonus stuff). Controls well, I find the mining to be a lot of fun, and the upgrades are cool. A fun game and an improvement on the original.

This game's early 2d platforming is INCREDIBLY reminiscent of the gameplay of the original Robocop on NES; spoken as someone who spent $45 in 1988 lawnmowing money ($127 adjusted for 2026) to get that NES cart.  I'm loving the T2 pixel art of Ed, Furlong et al and I'm only 20 minutes in.  I'm looking forward to outrunning an 18-wheeler on a motorbike,

Honestly currently for the price tag I don't recommend this game. And it truthfully has nothing to do with any of the game features or how it plays. Its simply that I paid 60 dollars for a 15 hour story game and I was going very slow. You could probably speed run the story in under a hour if you could skip every cutscene. Also in the story sometimes it feels the game is doing all the work and not you.
